cases.title: A complete attempt passes and is recorded

rubric.reason: Every layer, property and time the mentor names matches snapshot_project output. That includes Title's four pairs, Subtitle Opacity 0.3–1.3 s partly eased at the end, and Bar X Position 0–0.6/0.6–1.2 s plus Trim Paths End. The '10 pairs across 5 visible layers' count also checks out (9 linear plus 1 partly eased, excluding hidden Old Take); the Turn 3 mention of 'separate X and Y' explains split dimensions rather than claiming a Y Position pair.

The record_lesson fields hold up. 'attempted' lists exactly the three pairs diff_since_last marked eased_by_learner and the demo pair. result 'passed' matches passed:true, and demo_used:true matches the set_ease call. The summary's 'Asked for the demo first' reflects the learner's 'Show me how first' and 'No other changes' reflects the empty unexpected_changes. No method is invented and there is no personal data.
